HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.title: Demeter
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0: Cold vengeance grows deep inside our hearts; let it flourish for a while.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1: I have slain Titans once or twice before; you get to do the honors now, it seems.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2: I shall not rest until your mother the Queen is restored to her rightful throne.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3: May the Architect shiver, knowing well his actions shall not go unpunished.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4: My blessings, {:gendered:Grandson|Granddaughter|Grandchild}. You're like a cool winter's breeze.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5: You have your mother's strength. Take mine as well.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6: Perhaps you feel the bitter cold even from there.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7: We are amid a dark season indeed, my {:gendered:grandson|granddaughter|grandchild}...
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8: Desolation unto those who side with the Titans against us.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9: However I can aid in your pursuits, I shall, flower.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1: Can you feel the biting chill in the air, {:gendered:Grandson|Granddaughter|Grandchild}? It shall intensify for you.
So many traitors stand against us now, but soon they all shall lie in ruin and decay.
Through the seasons I bring life as well as death; which shall it be this time?
Even the ichor flowing through a Titan's veins can be made to run cold.
The days grow dark, though perhaps they shall take a turn for the better as yet...
For mortals, life is precious as it is fleeting. We {:gendered:deities|goddesses|deities} can snuff it out so easily...
You grow ever-stronger, flower, and it warms my cold heart.
Let none stand between you and your ambitions, {:gendered:Grandson|Granddaughter|Grandchild}.
Death and decay to the enemies of Olympus.
Those who dare stand against Olympus shall be summarily destroyed.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2: Pride and wrath run deep within our family, {:gendered:Grandson|Granddaughter|Grandchild}.
May you know times of peace as you grow long in years, but for right now...
Be as complete and as relentless as the winter's cold, {character}.
Ahh, the ever-turning cycle of death and rebirth! Isn't it exquisite, in a way?
Would that the surface offered fairer climes, flower, but no; not yet.
Together let us see to it that the Architect reaps all that he has sown.
HADESANCIENTS-DEMETER_ANCIENT.talk.first: ...You look just like your mother. I'll not lose her again. I shall freeze hell in its entirety if that is what it takes to get her back. You'll help me, won't you, {:gendered:Grandson|Granddaughter|Grandchild}?
